map.输入 Z 统计量，用正态分布近似快速估算双尾 Z 检验的 p 值，并提示 p<0: Enter the Z statistic and use a normal distribution approximation to quickly estimate the two-tailed p value of a Z test, with a note that p<0.05 usually means rejecting the null hypothesis at the 5% level; useful for a fast significance judgment in large-sample hypothesis tests.
map.给定 z 求双尾 p=2(1−Φ(|z|))。: Given z, find the two-tailed p = 2(1 - Phi(|z|)).
map.：p=2(1−Φ(1.96))=2×0.025=0.05，恰为 5% 显著界。: p = 2(1 - Phi(1.96)) = 2 x 0.025 = 0.05, exactly the 5% significance boundary.
map.：p=2(1−Φ(2.58))≈2×0.0049≈0.0098，约 1% 显著。: p = 2(1 - Phi(2.58)) = about 2 x 0.0049 = about 0.0098, significant at about 1%.

map.p 值含义？: What does a p value mean?
map.在原假设成立下，观察到当前或更极端结果的概率。p 小≠效应大，只说明\"不太像随: Under the null hypothesis, the probability of observing the current result or something more extreme. A small p does not mean a large effect; it only means "this is unlikely to be random".
map.无方向假设时两侧极端都算异常，双尾 p 是单尾两倍，更保守。: With no directional hypothesis, both extremes count as abnormal, so the two-tailed p is twice the one-tailed p and is more conservative.
